features: OVER-EAR WIRELESS HEADPHONES BUILT TO SHAME YOUR OLD EARBUDS – The P9 wraps your ears in Hi-Fi stereo sound with deep, punchy bass that makes every song feel like a front-row concert. Still using those tin-can earphones? Cute. Wrong, but cute.

20 HOURS OF BATTERY – OUTLASTS YOUR SHIFT, YOUR PLAYLIST & YOUR EXCUSES – One full charge powers a complete day of music, calls, gaming and binge-watching. While other headsets beg for a charger by lunch, this one's still going strong. Who's the real workhorse now?

BLUETOOTH 5.0 – PAIRS FASTER THAN YOU BLAME THE INTERNET – Instant, rock-stable connection within 10 metres means zero lag in gaming and zero awkward "hello? Can you hear me?" moments on calls. Wires? Sorry, we don't know them.

MEMORY FOAM CUSHIONS SO SOFT, YOUR EARS MIGHT FILE A COMPLAINT – Plush earpads hug your ears while the lightweight adjustable headband disappears on your head – even after hours. Those hard plastic buds leaving dents? That's a you problem. Upgrade or keep suffering.

BUILT-IN MIC + WORKS WITH EVERYTHING YOU OWN – Crystal-clear handsfree calling, plus seamless pairing with Android, iOS, laptops, PCs and tablets. If your device has Bluetooth, congrats – it's compatible. Now that's what flexibility actually looks like.
